product_metadata.title: nuLOOM Rigo Hand Woven Farmhouse Jute Area Rug, 6' x 9', Black
features: The perfect combination of style and durability, our jute rugs bring home effortless sophistication––perfect for your living room, dining room, kitchen, or hallway
Sleek and functional 0.35” pile height allows for convenient placement in entryways, underneath furniture, and will not obstruct doorways
Sprouting and shedding are common due to being made from plant fibers, trim any loose threads with scissors and regularly clean under your rug
Vacuum your jute rug 1-2 times a week on the lowest power level or with handheld attachment and spot clean as needed with mild detergent
We recommend pairing with a nuLOOM rug pad for added comfort and reduce friction and shedding
description: Looking for a simple way make your space feel polished? This farmhouse jute area rug will be the finishing piece you’ve been looking for. Hand woven and braided in India, this rug is made from renewable fibers, and is versatile enough to be used alone or as a base for a rug with vibrant color or texture. Handcrafted with love and care, each piece is marked by subtle but individual differences to make your rug unique. Create the home you’ve always dreamed of with our pet-friendly and easy to care for area rugs.
